turns.content: I'm planning a trip to Japan in the spring. Cherry blossom season. I'm so excited.
Japan during cherry blossom season is spectacular. Which cities are you thinking of visiting?
Tokyo definitely, and Kyoto. Maybe Osaka too if the timing works.
That's a classic route. Are you planning to use the Shinkansen between cities?
Yes, I got a JR Pass. It works out much cheaper than individual tickets.
Good call. Kyoto in early April is magical. Have you thought about which temples you want to prioritise?
Fushimi Inari is top of my list. I want to do the early morning walk before the crowds arrive.
Starting before 7am makes a huge difference. The light through the torii gates at dawn is something else.
